summary: OpenAI Performance Modeling Engineer ~2 is promoted to the top of Apply Now after official verification. It is explicitly early-career (1-2 years), maps unusually well to AutoScout profiling/simulation, distributed scaling, NCCL and vLLM work, and lists $293,000-$385,000 plus equity. Gmail shows no OpenAI confirmation yet, so submission remains uncertain rather than being guessed. Two new Apple IS&T Early Career location variants are live but are generic enterprise/full-stack roles and do not displace the more relevant Apple AiDP Reliability role. No new Gmail application, OA, interview or rejection evidence was found.
